How a call works

One call, start to finish

  1. Your agent names the tool and its inputs. Here, IBAN Validation with one input.
  2. Strale runs it and answers. Clean, structured fields, with the source and the price on every result.
  3. Try it now. IBAN Validation is one of 11 free tools. Paste the request and run it; no key needed.
curl -X POST https://api.strale.io/v1/do \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "capability_slug": "iban-validate",
    "inputs": {
      "iban": "SE4550000000058398257466"
    }
  }'
{
  "result": {
    "status": "completed",
    "price_cents": 0,
    "output": {
      "bban": "50000000058398257466",
      "valid": true,
      "bank_code": "500",
      "check_digits": "45"
    },
    "provenance": {
      "source": "iban-validate:algorithmic"
    }
  }
}

Pricing

Pay per call. Two ways to do it.

No subscription and no contract. Every tool has one price, and a call that fails costs nothing.

Pricing in full

An API key and a balance

One account and one key for every tool. Top up a EUR balance by card and each paid call is charged from it.

  • EU VAT Validation €0.02per call
  • Invoice and Receipt Extraction €0.50per call
  • Sanctions Check €0.20per call

A wallet, with no account

Your agent pays each request in USDC on Base over x402. 274 tools take it today.

  1. 1Call the tool, with no key
  2. 2Get a quote: EU VAT Validation, $0.0216
  3. 3Pay and get the answer, in one retry

Quality

Tested, with the results in the open

Strale runs its own tests on its tools, from known answers to checks that the source is up, and publishes the results tool by tool.
